# One-Day Vegan Meal Plan for Competitive Soccer Player

**Athlete Profile:** 178 cm, 72 kg | Daily caloric target: ~3,000-3,200 kcal | High protein focus (1.6-1.8g per kg body weight)

---

## **BREAKFAST** (7:00 AM) - 650 kcal
**Protein Pancakes with Berries & Almond Butter**
- 2 oat flour pancakes (made with plant-based protein powder)
- 1 cup mixed berries
- 2 tbsp almond butter
- 1 cup fortified soy milk
- 1 banana

*Macros: 25g protein | 85g carbs | 18g fat*

---

## **MID-MORNING SNACK** (10:00 AM) - 350 kcal
**Pre-Training Energy Boost**
- Smoothie bowl:
  - 1 cup unsweetened almond milk
  - 30g pea protein powder
  - 1 medium apple
  - 1 tbsp tahini
  - Granola topping (3 tbsp)

*Macros: 20g protein | 45g carbs | 12g fat*

---

## **LUNCH** (1:00 PM) - 750 kcal
**Quinoa & Chickpea Buddha Bowl**
- 1 cup cooked quinoa
- 1 cup roasted chickpeas (seasoned)
- 2 cups mixed greens
- ½ avocado
- Roasted sweet potato (150g)
- Tahini dressing (2 tbsp)
- Cherry tomatoes, cucumber

*Macros: 18g protein | 95g carbs | 20g fat*

---

## **POST-TRAINING SNACK** (4:30 PM) - 400 kcal
**Recovery Shake**
- 1 cup coconut water
- 35g hemp protein powder
- 1 banana
- 1 tbsp almond butter
- Handful of spinach

*Macros: 30g protein | 50g carbs | 9g fat*

---

## **DINNER** (7:00 PM) - 800 kcal
**Lentil & Tofu Stir-Fry**
- 200g extra-firm tofu (pan-fried)
- 1 cup cooked brown rice or pasta
- 1 cup mixed stir-fry vegetables (broccoli, bell peppers, snap peas, mushrooms)
- ½ cup cooked lentils
- 1 tbsp sesame oil
- Garlic, ginger, low-sodium soy sauce

*Macros: 28g protein | 110g carbs | 16g fat*

---

## **EVENING SNACK** (Optional, 9:00 PM) - 200 kcal
**Chia Pudding**
- ½ cup fortified almond milk
- 3 tbsp chia seeds
- ¼ tsp vanilla
- Topped with 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds

*Macros: 9g protein | 15g carbs | 12g fat*

---

## **Daily Totals**
- **Calories:** 3,150 kcal
- **Protein:** 130g (1.8g per kg) ✅
- **Carbs:** 400g (5.5g per kg - optimal for soccer)
- **Fat:** 87g (healthy ratio)

---

## **Key Nutritional Strategies for Soccer Performance**

✅ **Protein Distribution:** Spread across meals for optimal muscle recovery  
✅ **Carbs:** 55-60% of calories for sustained energy during matches  
✅ **Pre-Training:** Light snack 2-3 hours before; easily digestible snack 30-45 min before  
✅ **Post-Training:** Protein + carbs within 30-45 minutes for recovery  
✅ **Hydration:** 3-4L water daily; electrolytes on intense training

# One-Day Marathon Training Meal Plan
**Athlete Profile:** 180cm, 70kg | Goal: High-carb marathon training

---

## **BREAKFAST** (7:00 AM)
*Before morning run or as recovery meal*
- **Oatmeal with berries & honey** (50g oats, 1 cup mixed berries, 2 tbsp honey)
- **Banana with almond butter** (1 medium banana, 2 tbsp almond butter)
- **Orange juice** (1 cup)
- **Greek yogurt** (½ cup)

**Macros:** ~550 cal | 80g carbs | 18g protein | 12g fat

---

## **MID-MORNING SNACK** (10:30 AM)
*2-3 hours before long run*
- **Energy bar or toast** (1 granola bar or 2 slices whole grain toast with jam)
- **Sports drink** (500ml, 6-8% carbs)

**Macros:** ~250 cal | 55g carbs | 5g protein | 3g fat

---

## **LUNCH** (12:30 PM - WITHIN 30-60 MIN POST LONG RUN)
*Critical recovery window*
- **Grilled chicken breast** (200g)
- **White rice** (200g cooked)
- **Steamed vegetables** (broccoli, carrots - 1.5 cups)
- **Olive oil drizzle** (1 tbsp)

**Macros:** ~650 cal | 75g carbs | 50g protein | 15g fat

---

## **AFTERNOON SNACK** (3:30 PM)
- **Chocolate milk** (1 cup, 2% milk)
- **Rice cakes with peanut butter** (2 cakes, 2 tbsp PB)

**Macros:** ~350 cal | 40g carbs | 15g protein | 12g fat

---

## **DINNER** (7:00 PM)
- **Lean ground turkey or salmon** (180g)
- **Sweet potato** (200g, baked)
- **Mixed green salad** (2 cups with olive oil dressing)
- **Whole grain roll** (1 roll)

**Macros:** ~700 cal | 70g carbs | 45g protein | 18g fat

---

## **EVENING SNACK** (Before bed)
- **Cottage cheese** (½ cup)
- **Honey** (1 tbsp)
- **Almonds** (small handful, ~15g)

**Macros:** ~200 cal | 15g carbs | 18g protein | 10g fat

---

## **DAILY TOTALS**
- **Calories:** ~2,700
- **Carbohydrates:** 335g (50% of intake) ✓
- **Protein:** 151g (22% of intake) ✓
- **Fat:** 70g (23% of intake) ✓
- **Hydration:** 3-4L water + electrolyte drinks during/after long run

---

## **Key Timing Strategy**
- ✓ **Pre-run:** Light carbs 2-3 hours before
- ✓ **Post-run:** High carb + protein within 30-60 minutes
- ✓ **Throughout day:** Consistent carb intake to fuel training and recovery
